# sophosfirewall_ipv4_group (Data Source)

Looks up an existing IPv4 address group by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sophosfirewall_ipv4_group" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the IPv4 address group.

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (Set of String) Names of the IPv4 address objects (`sophosfirewall_ipv4_address`) in the group. Membership is unordered. Omit it for an empty group.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.
